10166    #[test]
10167    fn resolve_shebang_single_level_kernel_order() {
10168        let dir = shebang_tmpdir("single");
10169        let interp = dir.join("fakebash");
10170        fs::write(&interp, FAKE_ELF).unwrap();
10171        let script = dir.join("script");
10172        // Interpreter with a single optional argument.
10173        fs::write(&script, format!("#!{} -x\necho hi\n", interp.display())).unwrap();
10174
10175        let argv = vec!["script".to_owned(), "arg1".to_owned()];
10176        let (path, out_argv, image) = resolve_kvm_shebang(&script, argv).unwrap();
10177        assert_eq!(path, interp);
10178        // Kernel order: [interp, optarg, script_path, original args after argv[0]].
10179        assert_eq!(
10180            out_argv,
10181            vec![
10182                interp.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
10183                "-x".to_owned(),
10184                script.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
10185                "arg1".to_owned(),
10186            ]
10187        );
10188        assert_eq!(image, FAKE_ELF);
10189        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
10190    }

10192    #[test]
10193    fn resolve_shebang_nested_accumulates_like_binfmt_script() {
10194        let dir = shebang_tmpdir("nested");
10195        let interp = dir.join("fakebash");
10196        fs::write(&interp, FAKE_ELF).unwrap();
10197        let mid = dir.join("mid"); // a #!-interpreter that is itself a script
10198        fs::write(&mid, format!("#!{}\n", interp.display())).unwrap();
10199        let script = dir.join("script");
10200        fs::write(&script, format!("#!{} -e\n", mid.display())).unwrap();
10201
10202        let argv = vec!["script".to_owned(), "arg1".to_owned()];
10203        let (path, out_argv, image) = resolve_kvm_shebang(&script, argv).unwrap();
10204        assert_eq!(path, interp);
10205        // Level 1: [mid, -e, script, arg1]; level 2 prepends [interp, mid].
10206        assert_eq!(
10207            out_argv,
10208            vec![
10209                interp.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
10210                mid.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
10211                "-e".to_owned(),
10212                script.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
10213                "arg1".to_owned(),
10214            ]
10215        );
10216        assert_eq!(image, FAKE_ELF);
10217        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
10218    }

10220    #[test]
10221    fn resolve_shebang_rejects_infinite_recursion() {
10222        let dir = shebang_tmpdir("loop");
10223        let a = dir.join("a");
10224        let b = dir.join("b");
10225        fs::write(&a, format!("#!{}\n", b.display())).unwrap();
10226        fs::write(&b, format!("#!{}\n", a.display())).unwrap();
10227
10228        let argv = vec!["a".to_owned()];
10229        assert!(resolve_kvm_shebang(&a, argv).is_err());
10230        fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).unwrap();
10231    }

10233    /// The build scripts' pin reader, bracketed against the inputs that
10234    /// first-match-wins got wrong. Included rather than imported because the
10235    /// reader is build-script code with no library home.
10236    mod reverie_pin_reader {
10237        include!("../reverie_pin.rs");
10238
10239        const A: &str = "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111";
10240        const B: &str = "2222222222222222222222222222222222222222";
10241
10242        fn dep(rev: &str) -> String {
10243            format!(
10244                "reverie = {{ git = \"https://github.com/rrnewton/reverie.git\", rev = \"{rev}\" }}\n"
10245            )
10246        }
10247
10248        #[test]
10249        fn a_single_revision_is_read() {
10250            assert_eq!(parse_reverie_pin(&dep(A)).as_deref(), Some(A));
10251        }
10252
10253        #[test]
10254        fn agreeing_revisions_are_read_once() {
10255            let text = format!("{}{}", dep(A), dep(A));
10256            assert_eq!(parse_reverie_pin(&text).as_deref(), Some(A));
10257        }
10258
10259        /// A manifest halfway through a bump names two revisions. First-match-wins
10260        /// silently returned the first; the canonical rule refuses to resolve it.
10261        #[test]
10262        fn disagreeing_revisions_are_refused() {
10263            let text = format!("{}{}", dep(A), dep(B));
10264            assert_eq!(parse_reverie_pin(&text), None);
10265        }
10266
10267        /// The reported reproduction: ONE commented line above the live pin made
10268        /// the binary embed the comment's revision, so a correctly staged runtime
10269        /// would be refused by a guard naming a revision that was never the pin.
10270        #[test]
10271        fn a_commented_out_dependency_is_not_the_pin() {
10272            let text = format!("# {}{}", dep(B), dep(A));
10273            assert_eq!(
10274                parse_reverie_pin(&text).as_deref(),
10275                Some(A),
10276                "a commented-out revision must not win"
10277            );
10278        }
10279
10280        #[test]
10281        fn a_manifest_naming_no_revision_yields_none() {
10282            assert_eq!(parse_reverie_pin("[dependencies]\nlibc = \"0.2\"\n"), None);
10283        }
10284
10285        /// An unparseable Reverie line could be hiding a disagreement, so it makes
10286        /// the manifest ambiguous rather than being skipped as absent.
10287        #[test]
10288        fn an_unparseable_revision_is_ambiguous() {
10289            let text = format!(
10290                "{}reverie-x = {{ git = \"https://github.com/rrnewton/reverie.git\", rev = \"beef\" }}\n",
10291                dep(A)
10292            );
10293            assert_eq!(parse_reverie_pin(&text), None);
10294        }
10295    }

10297    /// SaBRe's guest plugin has no subscriber, so it forwards DETLOG records by
10298    /// the policy the CLI hands it. For each filter the CLI builds, that policy
10299    /// must answer every emitting module as the CLI's own subscriber does,
10300    /// which is what each in-process `detlog!` callsite asks under ptrace.
10301    /// `warn,detcore::random=info` once yielded no forwarding at all, because
10302    /// only the generic `detcore` target was asked, so SaBRe dropped the
10303    /// AT_RANDOM and early getrandom records ptrace prints.
10304    #[cfg(feature = "sabre")]
10305    #[test]
10306    fn sabre_detlog_forwarding_answers_each_target_as_the_cli_filter_does() {
10307        use detcore::detlog::ForwardPolicy;
10308        use detcore::detlog::info_enabled_for_target;
10309        use tracing::level_filters::LevelFilter;
10310        use tracing_subscriber::layer::SubscriberExt;
10311
10312        use crate::liteinst_bootstrap::EffectiveFilter;
10313
10314        let targets = [
10315            "",
10316            "detcore",
10317            "detcore::random",
10318            "detcore::randomness",
10319            "detcore::tool_local",
10320            "detcore::scheduler",
10321            "detcore::scheduler::runqueue",
10322            "detcore::syscalls::files",
10323            "hermit",
10324            "warn",
10325        ];
10326        let policy_under = |raw: &str, level: LevelFilter| {
10327            let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry()
10328                .with(EffectiveFilter::from_directives_lossy(raw, level).into_filter());
10329            tracing::subscriber::with_default(subscriber, || {
10330                let policy = ForwardPolicy::from_current_subscriber(raw);
10331                let subscriber_says: Vec<bool> = targets
10332                    .iter()
10333                    .map(|target| info_enabled_for_target(target))
10334                    .collect();
10335                (policy, subscriber_says)
10336            })
10337        };
10338        for (raw, level) in [
10339            ("warn,detcore::random=info", LevelFilter::WARN),
10340            ("detcore::random=info", LevelFilter::WARN),
10341            ("detcore::random=warn", LevelFilter::INFO),
10342            (
10343                "warn,detcore=info,detcore::scheduler=off",
10344                LevelFilter::WARN,
10345            ),
10346            (
10347                "warn,detcore[work]=info,detcore::random=info",
10348                LevelFilter::WARN,
10349            ),
10350            ("", LevelFilter::INFO),
10351            ("", LevelFilter::WARN),
10352        ] {
10353            let (policy, subscriber_says) = policy_under(raw, level);
10354            for (target, enabled) in targets.iter().zip(subscriber_says) {
10355                assert_eq!(
10356                    policy.forwards(target),
10357                    enabled,
10358                    "RUST_LOG={raw:?} --log={level}: policy {policy:?} disagrees on {target:?}"
10359                );
10360            }
10361        }
10362
10363        let (scoped, subscriber_says) =
10364            policy_under("warn,detcore::random=info", LevelFilter::WARN);
10365        assert!(!subscriber_says[1], "the generic detcore target is off");
10366        assert!(scoped.forwards_any());
10367        assert!(scoped.forwards("detcore::random"));
10368        assert!(!scoped.forwards("detcore::tool_local"));
10369        assert_eq!(policy_under("", LevelFilter::INFO).0, ForwardPolicy::all());
10370        assert!(!policy_under("", LevelFilter::WARN).0.forwards_any());
10371    }

10373    /// In-guest LiteInst gets the per-target policy it is given next to the
10374    /// forwarding descriptor, and this build's fingerprint, in the launch
10375    /// record, with none of Hermit's variables left on the command; a policy
10376    /// that forwards nothing requests no forwarding.
10377    #[cfg(feature = "liteinst")]
10378    #[test]
10379    fn liteinst_launch_hands_the_guest_its_per_target_policy() {
10380        use std::os::fd::AsRawFd;
10381
10382        use detcore::detlog::ForwardPolicy;
10383        use detcore::in_guest_launch::InGuestLaunch;
10384        use reverie::process::Command;
10385
10386        use super::LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_ENV;
10387        use super::LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_POLICY_ENV;
10388        use super::forward_in_guest_detlogs_to;
10389        use super::in_guest_liteinst_launch;
10390
10391        let (sink, _peer) = std::os::unix::net::UnixDatagram::pair().unwrap();
10392        forward_in_guest_detlogs_to(sink.into());
10393        let removed = |command: &Command| {
10394            [
10395                LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_ENV,
10396                LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_POLICY_ENV,
10397                detcore::LITEINST_CONFIG_FINGERPRINT_ENV,
10398            ]
10399            .into_iter()
10400            .all(|key| {
10401                command
10402                    .get_envs()
10403                    .any(|(name, value)| name == std::ffi::OsStr::new(key) && value.is_none())
10404            })
10405        };
10406
10407        let scoped = ForwardPolicy::decode("0,detcore::random=1").unwrap();
10408        let mut command = Command::new("/bin/true");
10409        let (launch, duplicate) = in_guest_liteinst_launch(&mut command, &scoped).unwrap();
10410        let duplicate = duplicate.expect("a policy that forwards a target requests forwarding");
10411        assert!(removed(&command));
10412        let launch = InGuestLaunch::decode(&launch.encode()).unwrap();
10413        let passed = launch.forward_request.expect("the descriptor is passed");
10414        assert_eq!(
10415            detcore::detlog::tool_output_env_target(&passed),
10416            Some(duplicate.as_raw_fd()),
10417            "{passed}"
10418        );
10419        let sent =
10420            ForwardPolicy::decode(&launch.forward_policy.expect("the policy goes too")).unwrap();
10421        assert_eq!(sent, scoped);
10422        assert!(sent.forwards("detcore::random"));
10423        assert!(!sent.forwards("detcore::tool_local"));
10424        assert_eq!(
10425            launch.coordinator_fingerprint,
10426            Some(detcore::config_wire_fingerprint())
10427        );
10428
10429        let nothing = ForwardPolicy::decode("0").unwrap();
10430        let mut command = Command::new("/bin/true");
10431        command
10432            .env(LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_ENV, "9")
10433            .env(LITEINST_DETLOG_FORWARD_POLICY_ENV, "1")
10434            .env(detcore::LITEINST_CONFIG_FINGERPRINT_ENV, "0000000000000000");
10435        let (launch, duplicate) = in_guest_liteinst_launch(&mut command, &nothing).unwrap();
10436        assert!(duplicate.is_none());
10437        assert!(removed(&command));
10438        assert_eq!(launch.forward_request, None);
10439        assert_eq!(launch.forward_policy, None);
10440    }

10442    /// The forwarding policy answers as a real in-process `detlog!` record
10443    /// behaves under the CLI's filter: a record is logged only when both its
10444    /// `tracing::enabled!` hint and its event pass, and a directive with a
10445    /// field filter applies to the hint whatever its fields but to the event
10446    /// only when the event has that field. `info,<module>[{unused}]=warn`
10447    /// suppresses the record; the policy once forwarded it, because it probed
10448    /// only the event.
10449    #[test]
10450    fn detlog_forward_policy_matches_real_detlog_emission_under_field_filters() {
10451        use std::sync::Arc;
10452        use std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize;
10453        use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
10454
10455        use detcore::detlog::ForwardPolicy;
10456        use tracing::level_filters::LevelFilter;
10457        use tracing_subscriber::layer::SubscriberExt;
10458
10459        use crate::liteinst_bootstrap::EffectiveFilter;
10460
10461        struct Count(Arc<AtomicUsize>);
10462        impl<S: tracing::Subscriber> tracing_subscriber::Layer<S> for Count {
10463            fn on_event(
10464                &self,
10465                _event: &tracing::Event<'_>,
10466                _context: tracing_subscriber::layer::Context<'_, S>,
10467            ) {
10468                self.0.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
10469            }
10470        }
10471
10472        let module = module_path!();
10473        for (raw, level) in [
10474            (format!("info,{module}[{{unused}}]=warn"), LevelFilter::INFO),
10475            (
10476                format!("warn,{module}[{{unused}}]=trace"),
10477                LevelFilter::WARN,
10478            ),
10479            (
10480                format!("info,{module}[{{message}}]=warn"),
10481                LevelFilter::INFO,
10482            ),
10483            (format!("info,{module}=warn"), LevelFilter::INFO),
10484            (format!("warn,{module}=info"), LevelFilter::WARN),
10485            ("info".to_owned(), LevelFilter::INFO),
10486            ("warn".to_owned(), LevelFilter::WARN),
10487        ] {
10488            let emitted = Arc::new(AtomicUsize::new(0));
10489            let subscriber = tracing_subscriber::registry()
10490                .with(EffectiveFilter::from_directives_lossy(&raw, level).into_filter())
10491                .with(Count(emitted.clone()));
10492            let forwards = tracing::subscriber::with_default(subscriber, || {
10493                detcore::detlog!("probe record");
10494                ForwardPolicy::from_current_subscriber(&raw).forwards(module)
10495            });
10496            assert_eq!(
10497                forwards,
10498                emitted.load(Ordering::Relaxed) == 1,
10499                "RUST_LOG={raw:?} --log={level}: the policy and a real detlog! disagree"
10500            );
10501        }
10502    }
10503}
